title: Bump undici to 7.16 for the CVE-2026-4471 fix
body: undici 7.14 is affected by CVE-2026-4471 (request smuggling through a malformed Transfer-Encoding header). 7.16 fixes it. apps/api pins 7.14 through the lockfile.

title: Session cookie is not refreshed after the two-factor step-up
body: After a person completes the step-up, the session cookie keeps its old expiry, so they are signed out 30 minutes later mid-task. Expected: the step-up issues a fresh cookie.

title: Rate limit dashboard shows UTC instead of local time
body: The x-axis on the rate limit chart prints UTC hours. Every other chart follows the browser's time zone.

title: Add Retry-After to every 429 response
body: #612 added Retry-After on the limiter's empty-bucket path. The quota and burst paths still return 429 without it.

title: Customer export fails for workspaces with more than 10,000 sessions
body: The export job times out after 60 seconds for large workspaces. Two customers reported it this week.

title: Write the 4.11.0 upgrade guide
body: Cover the two breaking changes in 4.11.0: the new default for unmatched calls (#481) and the tool_call rename in exports (#479).

title: Webhook retries double-count delivery gaps
body: A delivery that succeeds on its third retry is counted as two gaps on the webhooks page.

title: Cut 4.11.0 release notes
body: Draft the 4.11.0 notes from the pull requests merged since v4.10.3 and cut a draft release.

title: Flaky checkout e2e on Safari
body: checkout.spec.ts failed 6 of the last 20 runs, all on webkit.

title: Rate limiter returns 500 instead of 429 when the key bucket is empty
body: An empty key bucket throws, and the error handler turns it into a 500. It should be a 429 with Retry-After.

title: Docs: explain cost centers
body: What a cost center is, where an agent's comes from, grouping on Spend, and the export.
